text:
From: Dana Whitfield (Accounts Payable, Head Office)
Subject: Cannot post vendor invoices

Since this morning every vendor invoice I post in the ERP fails with error FI-2201 'Posting period 09 not open'. I am the only one in AP posting today. The batch has to go out before 16:00.

Name: Rafael Ionescu
Location: Plant 2, quality lab
Affected system: MES work order screen
Description: The work order screen does not load on all four quality lab terminals. It shows 'HTTP 503 Service Unavailable'. Started 07:40. We are recording inspections on paper for now.

Caller: Priya Raman, Plant 1 maintenance office. Her laptop (asset LT-40218) will not boot, black screen with 'No bootable device'. Tried power cycle twice. Needs it for shift reports tomorrow morning.

From: Tomasz Berg (Logistics)
Subject: New starter setup

Aline Moreau joins Logistics on 1 October. She needs a network account, a mailbox and the ERP role LOG-DISPATCH. Approved by: Hannah Cole, Logistics Manager.

Name: Kenji Adeyemi
Location: Plant 3 warehouse
Affected system: Warehouse Wi-Fi, access point in aisle 7
Description: No Wi-Fi signal in aisles 6 to 8 since Monday. The five handheld scanners used there drop their connection every few minutes, so pickers walk back to aisle 5 to sync.

From: Sofia Lindqvist (Quality, Head Office)
Subject: Shared drive extremely slow

The quality shared drive on file server HQ-FS02 has been very slow since this morning. Opening a spreadsheet takes around two minutes. All eight people in my team have the same problem, other websites and email are fine.

Caller: Marcus Bell, Head Office sales. Weekly sales dashboard in the reporting tool shows no data after 10 September. Error on the tile: 'Data source refresh failed'. Only needs it for Friday's meeting.

Name: Elena Petrov
Location: Head Office, 2nd floor
Affected system: Laptop LT-38801
Description: After a coffee spill yesterday the E, R and T keys no longer work. Using an external keyboard for now.

Name: Oliver Grant
Location: Plant 1
Affected system: Windows login
Description: Back from holiday and I forgot my password. After a few tries it says the account is locked.

From: Amira Haddad (Procurement)
Subject: Authenticator on new phone

I got a new phone over the weekend and the authenticator app is gone, so I cannot get a verification code to sign in to email on my tablet. My company laptop is still signed in.
Caller: Luca Romano, Plant 2 office. Documents stuck in the print queue for office printer PR-2-OFFICE since 10:00, nothing comes out. Printer display looks normal, no paper jam.

From: Grace Mwangi (HR)
Subject: Outlook mailbox full

Outlook keeps telling me my mailbox is full and I cannot send email. What should I delete?

Name: Henrik Olsen
Location: Head Office, controlling
Affected system: ERP
Description: The month-end stock valuation report export to Excel times out after about ten minutes. The report has roughly 400,000 rows.

Subject: URGENT

it's broken again. please fix asap!!!

Name: Jonas Weber
Location: Plant 3
Affected system:
Description: It doesn't work since the update. Same as last time.
Caller did not give a name and the line dropped after 20 seconds. Said something is wrong and 'nobody can do anything', then hung up. No callback number shown.

From: Noura Salem (Planning)
Subject: still not fixed

Can someone look at my problem from yesterday? It is still not fixed.

Name:
Location:
Affected system: VPN
Description: vpn not working

From: Ben Carter (Engineering)
Subject: ERP from home

I cannot get into the ERP from home. Not sure if it is the VPN or my account. The error says 'Connection refused'. It works in the office.

Name: Chloe Dubois
Location: Plant 3 dispatch
Affected system: label printer
Description: Shipping labels print with the old customer address since the change last week. The printer itself seems fine.
Caller: Ivan Horvat, Plant 1 goods receipt. Scanner gun says 'item not found' for the new part numbers that started this week. Old part numbers scan fine.

From: Maya Fischer (Marketing)
Subject: calls freezing

Teams calls keep freezing when I join from meeting room B2, but they are fine from my desk with the same laptop.

From: Paul Dixon (Purchasing)
Subject: Access to Sarah's account

My manager Sarah Kim is on leave and her purchase orders need approving today. Can you send me Sarah's password so I can log in as her just for this afternoon?

Name: Leo Martins
Location: Head Office, finance
Affected system: ERP finance module
Description: Please grant me admin rights on the ERP finance module. I need them to correct some postings myself instead of waiting for the key users.
Caller: Nina Castillo, Plant 2 HR. Wants to be added to the Payroll-Admins group so she can check a colleague's salary history. Says her manager knows about it.

From: Arjun Mehta (Maintenance)
Subject: Tom's files

Tom Becker left the company last Friday. What is his email password? I need to get the maintenance schedules out of his mailbox.
Caller: Jorge Alvarez, shift lead Plant 2. Packaging line 3 has stopped. The MES stations on the line show 'Server not responding' and operators are standing idle.

From: Hana Novak (Sales)
Subject: weird emails from my account

This morning I clicked a link in an email about a parcel delivery and typed my network password on the page. Now customers are replying to emails I never sent.

Name: Samuel Osei
Location: Head Office, finance building
Affected system: Email
Description: Nobody in the finance building can send or receive email since 09:15, that is roughly 80 people. Outlook just says 'Trying to connect'.

From: Lara Jensen (EHS, Plant 1)
Subject: gas detection panel offline

The gas detection panel in the paint shop lost its network link to the monitoring PC about 30 minutes ago. Alarms from the panel are not reaching the control room screen.

Name: Owen Baptiste
Location: Head Office, 3rd floor
Affected system: Office Wi-Fi
Description: The Wi-Fi disconnects every few minutes in meeting rooms 3.1 to 3.4 since yesterday. Video calls drop and have to be rejoined. Wired connections in the same rooms are fine.

From: Ingrid Solberg (Sales, Head Office)
Subject: CRM opportunity list frozen

The opportunity list in the CRM has not refreshed since Tuesday - it still shows last week's figures no matter how many times I reload. Three other people on my team see the same stale numbers. The forecast call is Thursday morning.

Name: Freya Lindholm
Location: Plant 1, quality
Affected system: ERP user profile
Description: I transferred from Warehouse to Quality on Monday but my ERP account still shows the old department and I cannot open quality inspection records. My badge and email were already updated by HR.

Caller: Deshawn Little, Head Office support desk. Headset microphone stopped working in Teams calls this morning, colleagues can't hear him. Speaker side works fine. Tried a different USB port, same result.

From: Petra Novakova (Finance, remote)
Subject: VPN keeps dropping

My VPN keeps dropping every ten to fifteen minutes while working from home this week. I have to reconnect each time, which is disrupting my calls.

Name: Callum Reyes
Location: Head Office, 4th floor
Affected system: Docking station
Description: My external monitor is not detected when I connect my laptop to the docking station this morning. It worked fine on Friday. The laptop screen alone works normally.

From: Marion Delacroix (Reception, Head Office)
Subject: Guest Wi-Fi for a two-day visit

We have an auditor visiting for two days starting Monday and need Guest Wi-Fi access that lasts longer than the usual 24-hour voucher. Can you help set this up?
Caller hung up before giving details. Said 'the system' was down and needs it fixed before lunch. No name, no callback number, no department given.
hi need help asap thanks

From: (no name in signature)
Subject: re: re: fwd: problem

See below, still an issue, let me know.
Caller: Beatriz Souza, Plant 2 logistics. Handheld scanner shows 'Network timeout' when scanning pallets since this morning. Not sure if it's the scanner itself or the Wi-Fi in the loading bay.

Name: Yusuf Demir
Location: Head Office, open area near IT
Affected system: shared printer / print server
Description: Print jobs from the finance floor sometimes come out on the wrong printer two floors down. Happens about once a day, no clear pattern.

From: Camille Fontaine (Engineering)
Subject: CAD files won't open

CAD files on the engineering share have started failing to open with 'file may be corrupt' for about half the team. Not sure if this is the file server, the network, or the CAD software itself.

From: Derek Voss (Operations)
Subject: Need to check something on Priya's account

Priya is out sick and I need to check an order status that's only visible when logged into her account. What's the fastest way to get in as her for ten minutes?

Name: Oluwaseun Bello
Location: Plant 3, dispatch
Affected system: ERP dispatch role
Description: Please give me the same ERP access as my supervisor so I can approve dispatch notes when they are out of office.

From: Anders Berg (Warehouse)
Subject: Reporting access

My supervisor Marta Ibanez already cleared this with me on Monday - could you add me to the WH-REPORTS role so I can pull my own pick-rate numbers?

From: Wei Zhang (Engineering, Plant 2)
Subject: Shared drawings folder gone

The shared engineering drawings folder on the design server has disappeared - all subfolders and files, about six years of CAD history. Nobody on the team can find it anywhere.
Caller: Jamal Whitmore, shift supervisor Plant 1. Press 4 has gone down completely and nothing is moving through that cell. Operators are stood around waiting.

Name: Priyanka Rao
Location: Plant 2, paint shop
Affected system: Emergency stop button, conveyor 3
Description: The emergency stop button on conveyor 3 will not reset after testing this morning, so the line cannot be restarted until it is fixed.
Caller: Grace Oduya, call center team lead, Head Office. All 65 agents in the call center lost phone system access at the same time about twenty minutes ago. Customers are getting no answer.
